title: Icon and type alignment study

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Compare icon geometry with adjacent lettering so symbols feel intentionally aligned rather than visually detached.
strategic_value: A common alignment logic can make Verizon’s icons and labels read as one interface element.
demonstration: A cropped bag icon, a circular person icon and outlined Sign lettering share black and blue construction guides.
practical_value: Inspect center alignment and text bounds together before settling an icon’s position beside a label.

content_islands.name: Icon construction
content_islands.spec: Place the large circular person icon between the cropped bag at left and lettering at right, retaining its internal outlines.

content_islands.name: Alignment guides
content_islands.spec: Carry a dashed blue center line from the person icon to the blue text bounding box and retain the black outer guides.

reference_purposes.Application: Construction lines compare icon bounds and the adjacent text box.
reference_purposes.Expression: Thin outlined icons and letterforms reveal the geometry underlying the interface pairing.

ingredient.name: Icon-label alignment
ingredient.role: Make a symbol and label read as a coordinated pair.
ingredient.application: Compare the icon center and bounds with the neighboring text bounds using the displayed construction guides.
ingredient.scope: Observed alignment study; no universal pixel offset is stated.
